title: Straw Men #8 Innovation All-American Comics 1990 Mutant Now Showing Horror Comic
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Straw Men #8 (1990), Innovation / All-American Comics. Cover shows a man in a blue suit in front of a "Mutant - Now Showing!" movie poster. Original $2.25 cover price ($2.85 in Canada).

Back cover: Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat #3 "Coming Soon" ad from Innovation.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
